sources.note: SEARCA's own programme page for the Full Master's and PhD Scholarship: eligibility, scholarship entitlements, study posts, application procedure, and the contact block naming the awarding body.
SEARCA's parent Graduate Scholarships page on the same official domain, carrying the general eligibility, scholarship support, and the application timeline with the submission deadline.

awarding_body.detail: The page is on searca.org, the awarding body's own domain, and names the organisation in full in its contact block. It is SEARCA's own site, not an aggregator, news article or student blog.
awarding_body.quote: Southeast Asian Regional Center for Graduate Study and Research in Agriculture (SEARCA), UPLB Campus, College, Los Baños, 4031 Laguna, Philippines

deadline.detail: The dedicated programme page shows no deadline, but SEARCA's official scholarships page publishes the application timeline with a submission deadline of 31 October 2026 to the applicant's Ministry of (Higher) Education. The 1 September-31 October 2026 window is open today (12 October 2026); results are released 31 May 2027. This matches the record's 31 October 2026 and is a currently-open cycle.
deadline.quote: Submission to the Ministry of (Higher) Education: 1 September–31 October 2026

eligibility.detail: The record carries no eligibility_summary, so there are no claims to contradict. The page states the actual eligibility, which is materially narrow: only nationals of SEAMEO member countries who are regular employees of academic or research institutions or government agencies, with age caps of 40 (Master's) or 45 (PhD), in specialisations relevant to agricultural and rural development.
eligibility.quote: Open to nationals of SEAMEO member countries who are regular employees of academic or research institutions or government agencies

funding.detail: The page states the programme is fully funded by SEARCA and lists tuition and other school fees, travel allowance (roundtrip air ticket from home country to study post and local transportation), thesis/dissertation support, book and supplies allowance, health insurance, and a stipend for food, lodging and incidental expenses. This is a full package, not tuition-only, so the record's 'Fully Funded' claim agrees.
funding.quote: The SEARCA Full Master's and PhD Scholarship Program is fully funded by SEARCA to support highly qualified individuals from SEAMEO member countries.

degree_levels.detail: The programme is explicitly the Full Master's and PhD Scholarship. The application procedure distinguishes applicants for the MS degree from PhD degree applicants, and study posts lead to master's and doctoral degrees. This matches the record's "Master's, PhD".
degree_levels.quote: PhD degree applicants should submit their original/certified true copy of BS and MS transcripts of records

recommended_field_updates.deadline_text: Submission to the Ministry of (Higher) Education: 1 September–31 October 2026 (applications go first through the applicant's Ministry of (Higher) Education; only shortlisted applicants upload via the SEARCA iSCHO Portal, 1–31 December 2026)
recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: The deadline is NOT on the dedicated programme page (full-master-phd-scholarships); it lives in the application timeline on the parent /scholarships page — re-checks must look there. Eligibility is restricted to nationals of SEAMEO member countries who are regular employees of academic or research institutions or government agencies, max age 40 (Master's) / 45 (PhD); the record's eligibility_summary is empty and should be populated with this constraint. Applications are routed through the applicant's Ministry of (Higher) Education, not sent directly to SEARCA. Study posts for this non-joint programme: IPB, UGM and UB (Indonesia), Kasetsart (Thailand), UPM (Malaysia), UPLB (Philippines).

notes_for_reviewer: The record's eligibility_summary is null; the live page shows the award is not open worldwide to the general public but only to SEAMEO member-country nationals employed by academic, research or government institutions — a human should decide whether that constraint must be added to the record. The programme page itself carries no deadline date; the 31 October 2026 date lives on the parent scholarships page, so future re-checks should check both pages.
